title: metadata filter: namespace part treated as RFC 6901 token (~ in namespace gives invalidArguments; invalid stored namespace key matches)
description: §3.6: the path is a namespace identifier then a JSON Pointer; a string that is not a valid namespace identifier matches no objects and does not produce an error. is_well_formed_metadata_path unescaped the namespace token, so metadataExists "acme~" was invalidArguments; resolve_path looked up any stored key, so "Acme.COM/x" matched stored legacy data.
